name: Word Logit, FinGPT
caption: nine shades; FinGPT 71.4% summed to three

details.title: What it is
rows: multinomial logit on word indicators: each distinct word of the text counts once; P(class) = softmax(intercept + sum of the known words' coefficients)
by the ridge penalty: every class keeps its own coefficients and no base category is fixed at zero
none: the model reads the words themselves (lower case, letters a to z, an inner apostrophe allowed)

details.title: Data
rows: FinGPT sentiment training set, the nine shades kept (the FinGPT Network's rows and folds)
31,700 words from the development rows; 17,217 of them appear in one text only
a word outside the vocabulary has no coefficient: it is N/A and adds nothing. On the confirmation rows 1,672 texts had at least one

details.title: Training
rows: maximum likelihood with an L2 penalty, solved by L-BFGS on the full sparse matrix: no stochastic gradient descent
C chosen by grouped cross-validation from 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3: C 1; final fit 200 iterations
30,327 words whose answer on their own puts more than 50% on one class

details.title: Scores
rows: Same rows, shades summed to three
accuracy 59.8%, macro-F1 0.597; 13% of its word occurrences were never seen in training
